matrix: The3-by34 star-membership matrix has column types e0(11 copies),e1(11),e2(10),p=e0+e2(1),p'=e1+e2(1).
completeness: After removing repeated column types, there are only five types in rank3. The only dependent triples are{p,e0,e2} and{p',e1,e2}. Of the five subsets of four types, all except{p,p',e0,e1} contain one of those triples. The remaining four-set is a circuit. A five-set cannot be minimal. Thus the listed496 circuits are all minimal dependencies, up to scalar and orientation.
trades: For two disjoint circuits a,b, sigma*(a*b^t+b*a^t) has zero diagonal and annihilates all three star indicators. Its nonzero entries are+1 or-1. If its sign matches absent/present edges, it gives a binary star-preserving trade, possibly moving the overlap vertices and changing vertex degrees.
rank_response: For a producer-certified PSD rank31 seed T, put alpha=a^t*T^+*a, beta=b^t*T^+*b, gamma=a^t*T^+*b. The sign of(1-sigma*gamma)^2-alpha*beta distinguishes PSD rank31, PSD rank30, and one negative eigenvalue exactly, as in rank31_switch_theory.json.
verified_counts: There are57145 disjoint circuit pairs beyond the10585 earlier rectangles, hence67730 pairs in this specified move family.
limit: Minimal circuits span the kernel, but pairs of minimal circuits do NOT exhaust all rank-two changes, let alone all higher-rank changes. This enumeration is not a proof of(A).
